caseName: Gerling Global Reinsurance Corporation of America v. Garamendi, Insurance Commissioner, State of California
caseNameFull: Gerling Global Reinsurance Corporation of America Et Al. v. Garamendi, Insurance Commissioner, State of California

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. The Court reversed the judgment below in American Ins. Assn. v. Garamendi, ante, p. 396. Therefore, certiorari granted, and case remanded for further proceedings.
